desc:
Step into the chaos of the capital in Response London, the next evolution of emergency roleplay on Roblox. Protect the city, save lives, or live your own civilian story in a dynamic open-world London.

🚓 Emergency Services
Join Police, Fire & Rescue, or Paramedics with specialist units, high-speed pursuits, intense incidents, and life-saving missions.

💰 Criminal Heists
Plan and execute major crimes including:
Bank Heists | Jewellery Robberies | ATM Raids

🚕 Civilian Jobs
Live a normal life with roles like:
Taxi Driver | Bus Driver | Postman

🌆 Explore London
Discover a detailed map filled with action, events, and opportunities around every corner.

🎮 Playable on Console, Mobile & PC

🚨 Will you serve the city… or break the law?
